description: Calculate an ASO (App Store Optimization) audit score (0-100) for an app. Returns the overall score plus an itemized breakdown of checks (title length, keyword usage, screenshots, ratings, etc.) so you can identify what to improve. Works without an API key (free tier, limited daily use per IP).

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

store_id.description: Store-specific app identifier. iOS: numeric track ID. Android: package name.

name: sonar_app_aso_score
title: ASO Score
